journey.name: Lift: the exercise library and exercises of your own
journey.description: Search and narrow the library from Lift, add an exercise from a search that finds nothing, change it, pick it on the Log sheet and log a set of it, then see its equipment locked. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On "Set up", which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip for now"
Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength", then scroll to "Exercises" under "On your own" and tap it

Verify that a page titled "Exercises" shows "Search exercises", the chips "Kettlebell", "Barbell", "Bodyweight", "Band" and "Mat", "134 exercises" and "Filters" with a chevron, a "New exercise" button in the title bar, and cards headed "Kettlebell · 30" and "Barbell · 20" (side by side on a tablet)
Type "PUSHUP" into "Search exercises"
Verify that "3 exercises" is shown with "Push-up", "Incline push-up" and "Pike push-up", in a card headed "Bodyweight · 3", each over "Reps · Upper body", and a "Clear" button
Tap "Clear"
Verify that the search is empty and "134 exercises" is shown
Tap the "Mat" chip
Verify that "47 exercises" is shown, starting with "The hundred"
Tap "Filters"
Verify that "Focus" (Upper body, Lower body, Core, Full body), "Measured by" (Reps, Time) and "Only yours" are shown
Tap "Time" under "Measured by"
Verify that "22 exercises" is shown, "Swimming" among them, "Cat-cow" and "Butterfly", and the button reads "Filters · 1"
Tap "Clear"
Verify that "134 exercises" is shown and the button reads "Filters"
Type "Copenhagen plank" into "Search exercises"
Verify that "No exercise matches “Copenhagen plank”" is shown with "Check the spelling, or clear a filter." and a button "Add “Copenhagen plank” as an exercise"
Tap "Add “Copenhagen plank” as an exercise"

Verify that a sheet opens over the library (beside it on a tablet, rising from the bottom on a phone) and shows "Copenhagen plank" in its "Name" field, "Bodyweight" and "Reps" selected, "One side at a time" off, "Full body" selected, and "Save exercise"
Tap "Time", turn on "One side at a time", tap "Core"
Type "Top knee on the bench" into the "Cues" field
Tap "Save exercise"

Verify that the library is shown, the sheet gone, still searching "Copenhagen plank", with "1 exercise": a card headed "Yours · 1" with "Copenhagen plank" over "Bodyweight · Time a side · Core" and a chevron
Tap "Copenhagen plank"

Verify that its page opens in a sheet: "Copenhagen plank" over "Bodyweight · Time a side · Core", "Cues" with "Top knee on the bench", an "Edit" button, no figure, and under "Your history" "Not logged yet. Its sets will show here."
Tap "Edit"
Verify that the same sheet shows "Equipment" and "Measured by" chips, and "Archive exercise"
Tap "Back" to close the sheet
Tap "New exercise" in the title bar, type "copenhagen PLANK" into the "Name" field
Verify that "One of yours already has this name." is shown and "Save exercise" is disabled
Tap "Back" to close the sheet, then "Back" to return to Train's Strength pillar
Tap "Start session", then "Add set or EMOM" in the title bar, then "Change" on the exercise card
Type "copen" into "Search exercises" and tap "Copenhagen plank"
Verify that the exercise card reads "Copenhagen plank" over "Bodyweight · Time a side · Core" with "Top knee on the bench" under it, and "Held" reads "0:30"
Tap "Log set" at the bottom of the sheet
Verify that the session shows "Copenhagen plank" with a set "0:30 · Left"
Tap "Add set or EMOM" in the title bar, then "Change" on the exercise card, then clear the search and type "Turkish sit-up"
Tap "Add “Turkish sit-up” as an exercise": the same sheet turns into the new exercise's form. Tap "Save exercise"
Verify that the sheet is back with its exercise card reading "Turkish sit-up" over "Bodyweight · Reps · Full body"
Swipe the sheet down, tap "Finish", then "Done"
Tap the "Exercises" card, type "copenhagen", tap "Copenhagen plank"
Verify that its page shows "Done 1 time · last" with today's date, "Your best" with "Longest 0:30", and a card with "0:30 · Left"; then tap "Edit"
Verify that the sheet says "Sets of it are logged, so its equipment and measure stay as they are." and shows no "Kettlebell" chip
Tap "Back" to close the sheet
Clear the search and tap "Goblet squat"
Verify that its page shows "Goblet squat" over "Kettlebell · Reps · Lower body", no "Edit" button, and "Not logged yet. Its sets will show here."

Verify that a card shows a figure holding a kettlebell at its chest: first standing still a moment with "Hold the bell by the horns at your chest, elbows down" lit under "Set up", then squatting down and standing up again and again, its bell changing colour as it goes, with "Pause" in the card's corner; under it a bar whose short first stretch (the set-up) stands apart from the rest, with a marker moving along it in step and staying in the rep once the set-up is done; and under "Each rep" the other two cues, the one the figure is doing lit with a bar of the bell's colour and the others dim
Tap "Pause"
Verify that the figure and the marker stop where they were and the button reads "Play"
Drag the marker along the bar from left to right
Verify that the figure squats down and stands up as the marker is dragged, and the lit cue changes with the bar's colour under the marker
Tap "Push the knees out and drive up through the whole foot"
Verify that the figure stops at the bottom of the squat about to drive up, the marker where the bar turns to the colour it drives up in, and that cue is lit
Tap "Hold the bell by the horns at your chest, elbows down"
Verify that the button reads "Pause", the marker goes back to the set-up's stretch with that cue lit, and after a moment the figure squats again, the marker carrying on into the rep
Tap "Back" to close the sheet, then "Back" to return to Train's Strength pillar
